paragraphs.text: Moving to a new country comes with a lot of bureaucracy — and often, you need to fill in many forms. Károly is practising with Meg some of the most important details that one can be asked when introducing themselves.

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: Hány éves vagy?

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: Harminckettő éves vagyok.
Meg asks Károly the same question. They laugh because Károly is not sure he wants to talk about his age.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: Hány éves vagy?

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: Harminc éves vagyok.
Then they exchange contact details. Károly asks for Meg's address and phone number.

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: Hol laksz?

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: Budapesten lakom. A címem Kossuth utca 10.

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: Mi a telefonszámod?

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: A telefonszámom: nulla hat, harminc, egy kettő három, négy öt hat hét.
Károly didn't quite catch the last part, and asks Meg to slow down.

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: Lassabban, kérem! Még egyszer?

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: Nulla hat, harminc, egy kettő három, négy öt hat hét.
Meg turns the question around and asks for Károly's address too.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: És a te címed? Mi a címed?

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: Petőfi utca 5.
They also mention Meg's birthday. It is a small piece of information, but the conversation feels increasingly natural.

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: Mikor van a születésnapod?

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: Áprilisban.
